claim: spec/proposal/test_proposal_commands.md, S5 (line 68), S16 step 3 (line 173), S17 (line 183), E1 (line 194), E2 (line 202), E5 (line 227) and E6 (line 236) each invoke `spex register input/new-change.md` (or equivalent) with no `--git-head` flag. S16 step 3, S17, E1 and E5 require exit code 0. S5, E2 and E6 require exit code 1 for a distinct reason unrelated to the flag: S5 for a file-not-found error, E2 for a permission-denied write, E6 for idempotency (already-registered proposal) — none of these three Thens' stderr expectations are about a missing/invalid `--git-head`. E4 (line 216-222) is affected too, at lower confidence: its Then requires a file registered via `spex register` to be visible in `spex log` output, which needs the register call to succeed, but its When names no proposal path and reads as prose about default-directory resolution shared across subcommands rather than a literal flagless invocation — triage should confirm whether it binds. S4 (line 57) is correctly excluded: no arguments means `ValidateArgs` rejects it before any flag check runs, so its usage-message Then holds under either reading.
authoritative_source: The same leaf's own S1 (line 31: `spex register input/new-change.md --git-head cafe1234`, Then: eid is `cafe1234:<slug>`) and S2 (line 41) both pass `--git-head`. arch_proposal_commands.md's Interface section (line 73) gives the synopsis unbracketed — `spex register <proposal-path> --git-head <sha>` — unlike the bracketed optional flags on `spex log`, and its 'spex register interface' prose (line 55-57) says the caller supplies the head 'exactly as for `spex emit`', which enforces the flag with `MarkFlagRequired` plus a `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$` pre-flight (cmd/spex/emit.go:19-20,91). arch_registrar.md line 17 gives the eid form as `<git_head>:<slug>` with no empty-head case. cobra@v1.10.2 validates positional args (command.go:968) before required flags (command.go:1007), confirmed against the built binary's existing required flag (`spex emit --proposal foo` → `required flag(s) "git-head" not set`).
evidence: If `--git-head` is enforced as required (matching the Interface synopsis and 'exactly as for spex emit'), S16 step 3, S17, E1 and E5 all fail at the flag pre-flight instead of reaching exit 0 as their Then sections require — those scenarios were written before this proposal added the flag and were never updated to pass it. S5, E2 and E6 fail differently under the same required-flag reading: cobra validates the single positional arg before the required-flag check, so all three still exit 1, matching their Then's exit code, but for the wrong reason — the flag pre-flight rejects them before the scenario ever reaches the file-not-found read (S5), the permission-denied write (E2), or the already-registered check (E6), so their stderr Thens ('contains a file-not-found error' / 'contains a permission-denied error' / 'contains a message indicating the proposal is already registered') fail. If the flag stays optional (the current implementation, cmd/spex/register.go:18, matches this reading), a bare `spex register p.md` succeeds and appends `{"eid":":<slug>",...,"git_head":""}` to the journal — contradicting arch_registrar.md's eid form and leaving a `":<slug>"` key no later `task_created --for` can address, silently reinstating the compat default this bead's proposal states it retires. Flagged in PR #254 review (thread on cmd/spex/register.go:18): 'file a drift report for the contradiction rather than silently picking the lenient reading.' Both readings are defensible from a different part of the same leaf/component, so the ambiguity is in this bead's own contract and cannot be resolved by implementer choice. A prior version of this report omitted S5 from the enumeration; applied literally its proposed_fix would have added the flag to the other six flagless scenarios and enforced MarkFlagRequired while leaving S5 flagless, reproducing the same contradiction on the next cycle.
proposed_fix: Add `--git-head cafe1234` (or another placeholder SHA) to the `spex register` invocations in S5, S16 step 3, S17, E1, E2, E5 and E6 of test_proposal_commands.md, matching S1/S2/S3, and enforce the flag as required in cmd/spex/register.go (MarkFlagRequired + the same `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$` pre-flight `spex emit` uses) so an absent or malformed head is refused before the journal append, not threaded through as an empty or unvalidated eid segment. Triage should also confirm whether E4's flagless prose invocation needs updating.
